scenario_scope: Intake of Corben Sorenson's RMWS preprint and reproducibility package as the causal owner of deployment-descended evidence and model-world trajectory governance.

cases.decision_rationale: Governed World Models currently reconciles predictions with observations, but does not own the case where deployment causally changes the observation and successor-training process. Reflexive closure, evidence ancestry, grounding reserves, and persistence-aware rollback require a separate model-world-evidence-lineage interface.
required_before_drafting: complete manuscript, code, data, and package review
source note distinguishing source-reported simulation results from local reproduction
explicit handoff from Governed World Models
Human Reader integration without increasing the 26-unit spine
evidence_transition_preconditions: pinned local reproduction of all supplied simulations
independent checks or mechanization of scoped propositions
held-out reflexive benchmark with causal identification controls
promotion_blockers: local rerun blocked by missing scikit-learn
toy simulations do not estimate deployed effects
no independent reproduction or real deployment evidence
non_claims: does not imply that reflexive systems collapse
does not equate stability with legitimacy or safety
does not establish causal descendancy from observational logs alone

validation_boundary: Records a distinct technical chapter boundary and bounded consumers. It does not promote the formal propositions, supplied toy runs, or deployment claims beyond their stated scope.
non_claims: does not create a Human Reader unit
does not authorize deployment or evidence reuse
